_metadata.expectation_basis: Each tier is computed from the raw label's blend row (printed total), its listed components and their printed amounts under the 21 CFR 101.36 rule in proprietary_blend_detector.disclosure_tier, checked by hand before the pipeline ran. A standardization marker is not a component.
_metadata.assertions: The blend reaches Enrich with the expected tier; no record claims full while listing an unquantified or no component; every unquantified member carries has_dose false (never a zero dose).
_metadata.known_defect: 74832, 243975 and 59514 also carry a duplicate blend record claiming full without that evidence (detector/cleaner merge). Registered in LEDGER; the invariant case is a strict xfail until fixed.

Preventative Nutrition Eye Health Formula
Contains clinically studied ingredients, additional key nutrients and a lifestyle program to support eye health.

Essential Vitamins & Minerals
Both vitamin A and beta-carotene are required by eyes for normal, healthy function. Also contains vitamins C and E and essential minerals such as selenium, copper and zinc that play an integral role in maintaining normal ocular function.
Antioxidant & Structural Support
Provides lutein, zeaxanthin and glutathione that work to protect eyes form oxidative damage. The superior form of lutein in this formula has been show to have 268% greater bioavailability than regular lutein. DHA is an essential omega-3 fatty acid found in the eye membranes and is an important structural component of the eye for healthy vision.
Blood Flow Support
Contains important nutrients to support healthy blood flow, which is essential for eye health, including resVida resveratrol, clinically shown to enhance blood vessel dilation.

In a randomized, double-blind, crossover study of 13 healthy volunteers, subjects took 20 mg of lutein in the form of Lutemax 2020 or regular lutein on two occasions.
